checks.detail: 中文标题准确表达相关性；背景、方法、结果、结论均完整忠实于官方公共摘要，无新增研究结果。
明确观察性队列；结论、one_line、why_read均使用关联语言，limits提醒不能等同因果结论。
OR译为比值比，未译为风险比或风险增幅，未把OR 1.43改述为风险增加43%。
15 640名、50至64岁、参与者10至12岁时父母可支配收入、国家登记来源和冠状动脉CT血管造影均准确。
节段受累评分≥4与冠状动脉钙化评分>100准确；未将节段OR数值误归给钙化结局。摘要只称后者类似关联，稿件保留该范围。
最低与最高父母收入五分位的OR及各调整结果全部匹配官方摘要；未擅称首个OR为未经调整。
四条quote分别是canonicalAbstract逐字子串；每条中文text中的所有数字、阈值、CI和P值均由该条自身quote支持。
准确概括儿童期收入与中年冠脉表型的观察性关联、成人风险因素未完全解释关联，以及摘要层面的因果限制；无干预建议或全文/医学审查声称。

reportedEstimates.context: lowest versus highest parental income quintile; segment involvement score ≥4
adjustment for traditional cardiovascular risk factors

quoteChecks.quote: This observational cohort study included 15 640 participants, aged 50 to 64 years, from the population-based SCAPIS (Swedish Cardiopulmonary Bioimage Study) who underwent coronary computed tomography angiography.

Participants in the lowest versus highest parental income quintile were more likely to have moderate-severe coronary atherosclerosis (segment involvement score ≥4; odds ratio [OR], 1.43 [95% CI, 1.20-1.71], P<0.001).
Similar associations were observed for coronary artery calcification >100.

conclusion: 独立公共摘要语义审校通过，无需修正。本结论仅覆盖官方公开摘要与其中文翻译和速览，不构成医学审查或全文精读；requested Sol backend actual unknown。

existingBehaviorBoundary.impact: The reviewed real c acceptance is not shown to violate completed-task intake protection. If the prohibition is intended to remain a runtime invariant after source-matched tasks later become complete, the existing runtime overlay behavior does not enforce it.
